Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1741187. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value is not null. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
